ai_summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited (ASHL) has successfully commissioned 57.69 MW of a Firm and Dispatchable Renewable Energy (FDRE) project in Rajasthan, integrating 100.02 MW of solar capacity with a 57.69 MW / 265.38 MWh Battery Energy Storage System. This commissioning, with a Commercial Operation Date of November 21, 2026, marks a material operational milestone, initiating revenue generation under an existing Power Purchase Agreement with NHPC Limited and advancing the company's 250 MW project. No immediate red flags are apparent, indicating positive progress in ASHL's renewable energy development.
